S2c0b65a261d7: InfoPanel for Linux, rebuilt on Avalonia. Based on InfoPanel by habibrehmansg.
Sbd5c96c4c315: The ASRock Steel Legend 360 LCD (USB 26CE:0A11) is now detected and driven as a 480x480 panel, with udev rules for access without root. It wakes the panel after a full power cycle, and puts it back to sleep when InfoPanel stops. Contributed by Ulfy.
S3714ab449323: The Extras plugins (MangoHud FPS, SMART drive health, Weather, System Info) failed to load when InfoPanel is installed system-wide (AUR package, /opt): their shared config was written next to the plugin assembly, which is read-only there. The config now falls back to the user data directory; an existing config next to the plugin keeps working.
Sbc4da74d74eb: NVIDIA GPUs now expose real per-fan tachometer readings (Fan 1 RPM, Fan 2 RPM) alongside the duty-cycle percentage, on driver 550 or newer; older drivers keep the percentage only. AMD GPUs gain an equivalent RPM sensor through ROCm, in addition to the RPM already provided by the kernel driver.
S6c5f37363e01: Every panel family gets the collapsible Panel options section with brightness, per-device target FPS, and JPEG quality where the protocol uses JPEG. Device cards show the native resolution for all models, BeadaPanel cards show friendly model names, and the Thermaltake 6 inch is verified on real hardware (24 fps at 17 ms).
S4771d74ab3a3: Fixed a native crash that killed the app seconds after start when a wedged panel failed its init handshake. Two identical Trofeo panels now reconnect cleanly after replug (each task claims its own device instead of both fighting over one), and pressing Scan no longer renames an identified 11.3 inch or 9.16 v2 back to the base model.
Sed99a31cbb5d: Serial Turing panels (Turzx 5 inch and friends) batch their protocol writes, lifting frame rates toward Windows levels. Trofeo 11.3 inch and 9.16 inch v2 keep their runtime identification: the device card updates live and the model persists across restarts. Disabled devices say disabled instead of idle.
Sd95bfcc15e79: Logout and restart no longer stall while InfoPanel is running: the app exits cleanly when the session ends and close-to-tray no longer intercepts OS shutdown. udev rules now cover the serial tty nodes of Turing/Turzx panels, so they work without dialout group membership. Fixed the tray Exit occasionally leaving the process behind.
